enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Pull blanket up. Sigh. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply body wash. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal time: reading news and checking personal messages
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through news. Tap on article. Read article. Swipe back. Open messaging app. Check messages. Reply to message. Type message. Send message. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put down book. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 2, boiling water with the kettle for tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out bread. Take out butter. Place on counter. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place on base. Turn on kettle. Pick up pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Butter toast. Pour tea. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Talk to Member 2. Drink tea. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone for work emails and news, planning the work-from-home day, light tidying
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Open email app. Check emails. Scroll through emails. Open news app. Read headlines. Put down phone. Pick up notebook. Write to-do list. Stand up. Pick up cushions. Fluff cushions. Place cushions on sofa. Pick up cloth. Wipe coffee table. Put down cloth. Adjust curtains. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Check calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on computer: coordinating community programs, answering emails, joining online meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Type replies. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open video conferencing app. Join meeting. Speak into microphone. Take notes. Leave meeting. Open document. Draft program plan. Type. Save document. Make phone call. Dial number. Speak. Hang up. Open spreadsheet. Update schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 2 using the induction cooker and microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Place in microwave-safe dish. Open microwave. Place dish inside. Close microwave. Press start. Wait. Take out dish. Place on counter. Open induction cooker. Place pan on it. Turn on. Heat food. Stir. Turn off. Serve onto plates. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Talk to Member 2. Drink water. Finish. Pick up plates. Walk to sink. Rinse. Load dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home on computer: drafting program plans, calling partner organizations, updating schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open document. Type. Make phone call. Dial. Speak. Hang up. Open spreadsheet. Update schedule. Save. Open email. Send email. Open document. Edit program plan. Type. Save. Make phone call. Dial. Speak. Hang up.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and having an afternoon snack with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place on base. Turn on. Open cupboard. Take out tea bags. Take out mugs. Place tea bags in mugs. Pour hot water. Add milk. Stir. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Place on plate. Sit at table. Drink tea. Eat snack. Talk to Member 2. Finish. Pick up mugs. Rinse.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing household chores with Member 2: vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in. Turn on. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under cushions. Turn off. Unplug. Wrap cord. Pick up items on floor. Place in basket. Wipe surfaces. Dust shelves. Arrange pillows. Talk to Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 2 using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Open oven. Place tray inside. Close oven. Set timer. Stir pan. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plates. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk to Member 2. Drink water. Finish.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Pick up glasses. Rinse. Place in dishwasher. Pick up cutlery. Place in basket. Close dishwasher. Wipe table. Push chairs in.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with Member 2 to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch. Talk to Member 2. Adjust volume. Change channel. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Drink water. Put down remote. Adjust pillow.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing: watching TV with the air conditioner on, playing a video game
enriched_activities.desc: Continue watching TV. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Select game. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Talk to Member 2. Adjust air conditioner. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down controller. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone, reading in bed with the fan on, then sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Check messages. Scroll social media. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Close book. Put down book. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
